title: How I Connected My Local Terraform Project to GitHub
brief: As a cloud enthusiast working on real-world Infrastructure as Code (IaC) projects using Terraform, After completing a Terraform course on Udemy, I was excited to start pushing real Infrastructure as Code (IaC) projects to GitHub not only for version control but to showcase my work. I thought it would be a smooth git init and push. Spoiler alert: it wasn't.

title: Installing PostgreSQL, Node.js, and Deploying a Node.js App on Amazon EC2 Instance
brief: Amazon Linux 2023 introduces some changes in package management. It uses dnf instead of amazon-linux-extras and provides PostgreSQL via AppStream repositories. This guide covers installing PostgreSQL, setting up a Node.js application, and ensuring it runs on an Amazon EC2 instance.

title: Step-by-Step Guide to Install, Configure, and Use MySQL on an EC2 Instance
brief: Why Set Up MySQL on an EC2 Instance? When it comes to hosting a MySQL database on AWS, you have two main options: Amazon RDS (Relational Database Service) or self-managed MySQL on an EC2 instance. Hosting MySQL on an EC2 instance gives you more control and flexibility over your database environment.

title: How to Host a Simple Static Website on AWS S3: A Step-by-Step Guide
brief: Amazon S3 (Simple Storage Service) is ideal for hosting static websites because it serves files directly to users without the need for server-side processing. A static website consists of fixed content — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, and other assets — delivered exactly as stored.

title: Build Amazon VPC with Public and Private Subnets
brief: A Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) is a customizable virtual network within the AWS Cloud, allowing you to define and control your own isolated environment for deploying cloud resources. It provides enhanced security and flexibility, making it a fundamental building block.

title: A Step-by-Step Guide: Using M-Pesa Virtual Card to Sign Up for AWS
brief: Imagine being able to create your AWS account without needing a physical bank card! Cloud enthusiast, Safaricom's virtual ATM card makes cloud access easy and seamless. In this post, I'll guide you step-by-step through setting up the virtual ATM card and using it to sign up for AWS.
